commands.text: Among the chairs going home, one has a strip of red cloth tied beneath the seat. Jori checks the knot before lifting it.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: This one belongs to the house with the low door.

commands.speaker: pippa_bell
commands.text: I remember the owner. She brought the sharp little onions.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: You remember everybody by the sound or the food.

commands.speaker: pippa_bell
commands.text: Very reliable methods of finding people at supper.
The repaired chair stays in the square, where the innkeeper said it could stay.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: Take the other side. The door is lower than the chair is wide.
